contract: Read-only local-day communications activity projection from canonical touchpoints, relationship messages, calendar events, social and assignment history. Stable provenance identities, person/kind filters, query-bound seek pagination, timezone correctness, scan limits and schedule-versus-attendance distinction. No competing event store.
acceptance: Canonical records merge with stable IDs and provenance links without duplicate desktop/mail mirror projections
Local-day DST/date boundaries, all-day calendar overlap/cancellation and strict person filters
Query-bound pagination, bounded scans and explicit incomplete local coverage
Real native/HTTP/Console filtering, source links, pagination and error journeys; no secret-bearing metadata in summaries
limits: Recorded communications activity only, not a complete human activity record. Calendar entries are schedules and never proof of attendance.
At most 10000 rows per canonical source are scanned; truncation is surfaced. Seek pagination follows current records rather than a frozen snapshot.
Shared native-tool, route and Page mounts are retained as integration evidence and excluded from owned-file accounting because adjacent communications slices extend them.
acceptance_coverage: Read-only projection merges canonical touchpoint, relationship-message, calendar, social and assignment history rows with stable provenance IDs and source links; mirrored desktop/mail rows are not duplicated.
IANA local-day boundaries cover DST, timed and all-day overlap and cancellation while strict person/kind filters exclude unrelated records.
Query-bound seek cursors, bounded per-source scans and explicit incomplete coverage prevent unbounded reads and cursor reuse across changed queries.
Actual native, HTTP and console journeys filter, paginate, follow safe source links and surface invalid dates/timezones without exposing message bodies, credential references or private reasons.
